pli-tv-bi-vb-pc87:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo itthālaṅkāraṃ dhārenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc87:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo itthālaṅkāraṃ dhāressanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc87:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc87:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc87:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo itthālaṅkāraṃ dhāressantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc87:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo itthālaṅkāraṃ dhāressantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc87:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo itthālaṅkāraṃdhāressanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc87:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
